name: Canyon_Resource_Indicators
description: Visual hints of resources embedded in rock types — ore veins, crystal seams, fossil deposits visible in canyon walls

questions.question: Can the player learn to associate specific rock types with potential resources such as basalt yielding iron or limestone indicating cave systems?
questions.answer: This feature teaches real science through gameplay — the core educational mechanic.

questions.question: Would a screenshot showing visible ore veins and crystal seams embedded in canyon walls be a compelling discovery marketing image?
questions.answer: This feature generates shareable moments and press coverage. Differentiator from competitors.

questions.question: Do resource indicators appear naturally embedded in strata such as veins, nodules, crystal seams, and fossil bands rather than floating UI markers?
questions.answer: This feature makes the universe feel real and alive through physical accuracy.

questions.question: Can resource indicators be implemented using existing UE5 decal actor systems or material-layer overrides without new C++ components?
questions.answer: Can be implemented with existing UE5 tools and Python modules. No pipeline blockers.

questions.question: Do resource indicators require a new resource-data model or can they use the existing geology module rock-type taxonomy?
questions.answer: Built on existing Chimera infrastructure. No new toolchain dependencies.

questions.question: Are detailed resource-vein indicators using nanite-favorable geometry compatible with UE5.8 virtual texture streaming?
questions.answer: Works in UE5.8 without engine modifications. Standard features.

questions.question: Can resource indicator decals and overlay geometry be rendered without exceeding 50 extra draw calls per canyon vista?
questions.answer: Minimal performance impact. Well within 30fps target on RTX 3060.

questions.question: Can colorblind players distinguish resource indicators via shape differences, shimmer effects, or tooltip descriptions?
questions.answer: Text-based output is screen-reader friendly. Color-coded states need pattern fallback.

questions.question: Do resource-rich rock surfaces produce a distinct scanning ping or mining-impact sound compared to barren rock?
questions.answer: Audio design deferred to v2. v1 uses text-only feedback.

questions.question: Are resource indicator placements deterministic and consistent across all clients so every player sees the same vein at the same spot?
questions.answer: Single-player only. Multiplayer is future scope.

questions.question: Can the community define new resource types and their corresponding visual indicators through data configs without touching C++?
questions.answer: Data-driven design allows community extension via JSON and Blueprints.

questions.question: Are resource names, tooltip descriptions, mineral identifiers, and gather instructions stored in localization tables?
questions.answer: All text strings are extractable to JSON for translation.

questions.question: Do resource indicators depend on the geology module having a complete rock-type taxonomy with resource-association mappings?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.

questions.question: Do resource indicators prove that the environmental demo produces actionable gameplay consequences via a gather-loop?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.

questions.question: Is this derived from the educational principle that visual geology knowledge should produce tangible gameplay rewards?
questions.answer: Derived from parent feature design. Proves the educational approach works.

questions.question: Do colorful resource indicators visually clutter the canyon wall or distract from the educational strata layers they sit on top of?
questions.answer: No conflict with existing features. Complements sibling features.

questions.question: What art-pipeline knowledge (decal authoring, material layering, mesh LODs) is needed to author resource-vein indicators?
questions.answer: Basic UE5 knowledge required. Standard engine tools.

questions.question: Do resource indicators serve the seed goal of exploration-driven gameplay where observation yields real gameplay advantage?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.

questions.question: What visual subtlety is sacrificed if resource indicators are 2D decals rather than embedded 3D vein geometry?
questions.answer: Building this defers other features. Worth the tradeoff for educational value.

questions.question: How do we know that visual resource indicators actually motivate players to learn rock types rather than just mining every visible vein?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.

questions.question: Does the chain see indicator -> identify resource -> harvest -> use reach a human player making a deliberate gameplay decision?
questions.answer: Directly serves the educational RPG goal. Player learns real science through gameplay.

questions.question: Does this need deeper sub-features such as a resource scanner tool, minimap overlay, or extraction animations, or are static indicators sufficient?
questions.answer: Basic UE5 knowledge required. Standard engine tools.

questions.question: Are sibling resource features missing such as a resource map, portable scanner device, or extraction spot animations?
questions.answer: No conflict with existing features. Complements sibling features.

questions.question: Is Demo_Canyon_Terrain specific enough about resource gameplay to fully scope these indicators without reopening parent questions?
questions.answer: Depends on parent feature being built first. No external blockers.

questions.question: Should resource indicators be built after strata visuals since they render on top of visible rock layers?
questions.answer: Build after parent feature. No blocking dependencies.

questions.question: Does incomplete resource indicators block the gathering gameplay loop, or can gathering work with text labels while indicators are built?
questions.answer: Build after parent feature. No blocking dependencies.

questions.answer: Yes. Sleepwalker can walk through this feature and verify state changes.
